title: Tour Pulse
subtitle: A five-minute survey for Leasing Associates
intro: We're designing new training on property tours, and we want it built around how you actually work. Your answers are anonymous and are only reported as group totals. There are no right answers.
purpose: Run before design starts to size the gap and find barriers, then again at 90 days. The confidence questions map to the four tour stages, so the same items become a before-and-after measure.

questions.text: How long have you worked in leasing?
About how many tours do you give in a typical week?
How many of your community's tours are self-guided?

sections.title: Your tours today
sections.lead: How confident are you in each of these on a typical tour?

questions.text: Building a personal connection in the first few minutes
Learning what the prospect needs before showing any homes
Choosing which amenities to show and tying them to the prospect
Ending with a clear next step the prospect agrees to
Sending a personal follow-up within 24 hours
What makes it hard to personalize a tour? Select all that apply.
options: I know little about the prospect before they arrive
I'm not sure which questions to ask
I worry personal questions could raise Fair Housing concerns
We're expected to follow a standard route

questions.text: What makes follow-up harder? Select all that apply.
options: Too many leads to keep up with
No reminder or task in the CRM
I'm not sure what to say beyond “thanks for visiting”

questions.text: Where would you most likely use tour training?
Which would help you most? Choose up to two.
options: Feedback from my manager on a real tour
A quick-reference card on my phone

questions.text: Think of your best tour in the last month. What made it work?
What's one thing you wish you'd learned sooner about giving tours?

howUsed: Q4 to Q8 set the baseline for each tour stage and are repeated at 90 days.
Q9 and Q10 separate skill gaps from time and system barriers, such as a missing CRM task.
Q9's Fair Housing option shows whether the training needs to make asking safe.
Q11 and Q12 confirm the mobile-first, practice-heavy format before it's built.
Q13 and Q14 supply real moments for scenarios and persona cards.
